verdict.rationale: First-party docs show official SDKs to build against: the Windows App SDK with WinUI 3, a WinUI 3 quickstart, and language support for C#/.NET, C++ (Win32, C++/WinRT) and Rust via the windows-rs crate. AI-oriented developer surfaces are also listed (Windows AI APIs for Copilot+ PCs, Windows AI Foundry toolkit). Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of SDK reference docs beyond page headings, independent or hands-on corroboration of building with these SDKs, and details on how the AI APIs/toolkit are actually consumed.
